description: This Java source file defines a final class 'ModifyFeaturePropertyLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl' that provides a builder implementation for creating responses and events related to modify feature property commands within a Ditto signals context. It includes inner classes for response and event factory methods, handling creation of success and error responses based on command execution outcomes.
